whatItIs.statement: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

whenToUse.statement: Use Switch for an on/off setting whose state changes independently.

howToUse.statement: Associate the Switch with visible label content and use checked/defaultChecked with onCheckedChange for controlled or uncontrolled state.

options.statement: Use size="sm" for the compact switch or the default size otherwise.
Use disabled to make the switch unavailable and aria-invalid to expose an invalid state.
